message.Title: Generally Available: Managed namespaces on AKS

Body.Content:
Managing namespace configurations across AKS clusters has traditionally required manual setup and ongoing maintenance, creating complexity and potential for misconfiguration. With the general availability of Managed Namespaces, AKS now enables users to easily deploy preconfigured namespaces with built-in lifecycle management. 

This feature simplifies the process of applying consistent controls across clusters, including ingress/egress network policies, RBAC, and resource limits/requests. By offloading namespace lifecycle management to Azure, teams can accelerate deployment, improve governance, and reduce operational overhead.

Learn more.
